about: Measured dua-reel styles (2026-11-23). Numbers are medians from reels downloaded, measured and deleted; captions/hashtags from all posts read through ScrapeCreators. Use them to make NEW reels; never reuse their footage, voice or exact texts.

oaun.camera: gentle push-in or drift on every shot (zoom 1.03 -> 1.14)
oaun.grade: warm: red above blue in 97 % of shots, mean luma 117

layout.top_right: day name in big white Ruqaa/Diwani + DD.MM.YYYY on a thin underline
layout.top_left: Hijri block: day number, month name in calligraphy, gold or teal crescent
layout.under_header: optional occasion line in yellow or cyan
layout.centre: one dua line, white bold Naskh, soft dark shadow, 2-6 words, changes with the voice
layout.bottom: handle in small caps; optional gold sticker for the day

footage: Quran on a stand or prayer mat

layout.top_centre: gold calligraphy title of the day or occasion (جمعة مباركة، دعاء الفجر، صباح الخير، ليلة المولد) + date DD/MM/YYYY + Hijri month in small white Ruqaa
layout.centre: one dua line, white Naskh, soft shadow, small heart between words sometimes

footage: sunset over the sea and waves
Quran with candles and prayer beads
the Prophet's Mosque and the Kaaba
camels in the desert at sunset
a swing or chair facing the sea
dxhmen.caption: «دعاء يوم <اليوم>» or «دعاء ليلة الجمعة» + one dua line + 🌷🌹🌺🌸 + 🤲
dxhmen.footage_library: rose.py library fetch dxh_pins --approve-write (152 clips); git branch media/dxhmen-pins

voices.library: rose.py library fetch dua_audio --approve-write (2,126 m4a: <account>/<day or occasion>/); git branch media/dua-audio
voices.rights: private study only; publish with the owner's voice or TikTok's in-app sound

texts: rose.py duas day <day> | rose.py duas show <occasion> (112 themes)
